summary: Iterates items from a container object and routes each item through sub_584130, then performs a final vtable dispatch. Two iteration protocols are selected by a flag byte: the first enumerates via the a1 object's vtable slots at byte offsets 0xA4/0xA8 (count + item-by-index) and reads a field from each item via ReadFieldAtOffset0x14 before calling sub_584130; the second enumerates via the v5 object's vtable slots at byte offsets 0x14/0x18 and passes each item directly to sub_584130. When sub_586CA0(a3) is non-zero the whole body is skipped and VTableDispatchWithConditionalCall(a3) is returned instead. Always returns 1 on the normal path. Invoked by NetworkSendDispatch.

local_names.a1: primary dispatch object (vtable slots at byte offsets 0x5C, 0xA4, 0xA8)
local_names.a2: secondary argument forwarded into the count and final dispatches
local_names.a3: context/container object (v5 = object pointer at a3+72, flag byte v5[4])
local_names.v5: container object pointer read from a3+72
local_names.v6: item count from the a1 vtable+164 dispatch
local_names.v10: item count from the v5 vtable+20 dispatch

operations.description: Alternate-path check: when sub_586CA0(a3) returns non-zero, return early with VTableDispatchWithConditionalCall(a3) and skip both iteration loops
Alternate path: return VTableDispatchWithConditionalCall(a3), a conditional list-append vtable dispatch used instead of the standard iteration
Load v5 = *(a3 + 72) and read the iteration-mode flag byte v5[4]
Branch on the flag byte v5[4]: non-zero selects the a1-vtable iteration path, zero selects the v5-vtable iteration path
On the a1 path: read the item count v6 via the thiscall vtable slot at *a1 + 164, invoked with (a1, a2)

On the a1 path: for i in 0..v6, fetch each item via the vtable slot at *a1 + 168 with (a1, i); when the item is non-null, read the field at offset 0x14 from it via ReadFieldAtOffset0x14 and pass it to sub_584130(a1, a3, value)

On the v5 path: read the count v10 via the vtable slot at *v5 + 20 with (v5, a2), then for j in 0..v10 fetch each item via the vtable slot at *v5 + 24 with (v5, j) and pass it directly to sub_584130(a1, a3, item)
After either iteration path, dispatch the final thiscall at *a1 + 92 with (a1, a3)
Invoked by NetworkSendDispatch (0057A6A0) as part of the network send dispatch system
